text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Narita Taishin seemed unusually in a foul 
mood that day.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Agh, honestly! It's so infuriating...!
choice_data_list: Did something happen?
Did something happen?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Forget whether it happened or not... 
dammit! Remembering it just pisses me off 
even more...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After somehow managing to get an 
explanation from an agitated Narita 
Taishin—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Apparently, an Umamusume she beat in the 
last mock race made some sarcastic remarks 
about her small build.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Things like, "Her win this time was a 
fluke," or "She won't keep winning if she 
stays a shrimp"—

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
*sigh*... Even for sour grapes, that's in 
seriously bad taste.
choice_data_list: That was rough, huh.
That was rough, wasn't it?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Seriously, give me a break... I've been 
feeling uneasy this whole time, and—

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
I've made up my mind...! Today, I'm going 
to run to my heart's content!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
I'm heading to the grounds ahead of you. 
...Later.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Narita Taishin said that and ran off.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, I met up with Narita Taishin 
and we went through our training, but—

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Haa, hah...
choice_data_list: Feeling refreshed?
Feeling better?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Not at all. My stomach still feels upset.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
...Regular training isn't gonna cut it. 
I'm gonna do some extra practice on my 
own, so head on home without me.
choice_data_list:
If anything, we should probably call it a 
day now.
If anything, you'd better wrap it up soon.
You can do it, but don't overdo it.
You can do it, but don't overdo it, okay?

Go right ahead and do whatever your heart 
desires!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
...Regular training isn't gonna cut it. 
I'm gonna do some extra practice on my 
own, so head on home without me.
choice_data_list:
If anything, we should probably call it a 
day now.
If anything, you'd better wrap it up soon.
You can do it, but don't overdo it.
You can do it, but don't overdo it, okay?

Go right ahead and do whatever your heart 
desires!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Huh!? How did it come to this!
choice_data_list:
It'd be awful if you overdid it and got 
sick, after all.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Still...!
choice_data_list:
Then you'd be playing right into their 
hands

Then you'd be playing right into their 
hands

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I tell her that resting properly and 
showing them the usual Narita Taishin 
would frustrate her opponents far more—

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Y-Yeah, you have a point, but...

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
...Understood. I'll head straight home and 
sleep today.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
It bugs me to do what you say, but making 
that person happy bugs me even more...

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: I'll make sure to go home.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The next day—perhaps thanks to getting 
plenty of rest, Narita Taishin's anger 
seemed to have cooled down.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Moderation, huh...? Doing things halfway 
doesn't feel satisfying at all, does it?
choice_data_list:
You should channel those feelings into the 
race.

You should channel those feelings into the 
race, okay?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Rather than letting anger run wild and 
overworking your body, it'll feel much 
better to tune yourself to perfection and 
take the win in the race.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
When I tell her that, Narita Taishin 
flashes a truly "wonderful" smile.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
...In other words, all I gotta do is beat 
the crap out of her in a mock race again, 
right?
choice_data_list: No, not quite that far...

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
I will. If I don't go that far, my 
irritation isn't gonna go away.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...Sounds good. Let's do this.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Just you watch...! I'll make sure you 
never look down on me again!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Burning with fighting spirit, Narita 
Taishin devised a plan to get back at the 
Umamusume who had made a fool of her.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Of course!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
This frustration isn't gonna go away that 
easily, you know.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna run and run and run until I 
completely forget about that jerk...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And—

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Raaaaaagh...!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Alright! Things are looking good.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Keep up this pace for one more lap...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Fired up with anger, Narita Taishin 
continued her independent training for 
quite some time afterward.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Damn it...!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
"It's not enough. I don't feel refreshed 
at all, and yet—"

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: My body... won't move anymore...

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Ugh...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Having pushed herself way too hard, Narita 
Taishin sat down on the spot and couldn't 
stand back up for a while...
